# Savona Foodservice Unveils £3 Million London Depot Expansion to Support Growth and Innovation

Savona Foodservice has officially opened the doors to its new London distribution depot, marking an exciting new chapter for our business and a significant investment in our future across London and the South East.

As our customer base and product range have continued to grow, so has the need for greater capacity. The 50,000 square foot site has given us a larger, more efficient facility designed to support our customers today while preparing us for future growth.

At the heart of the expansion is a significant increase in warehouse capacity, including over c. 2,000 additional freezer and chiller pallet spaces. This means greater product availability and the ability to offer an even broader range of products.

# XDP expands Carlisle presence

By Reuben Henry-Fellows 12th August 2026 2 Mins Read

UK-based delivery carrier specialising in irregular and out-of-gauge freight, XDP Ltd, has opened a new depot in Carlisle.

XDP Ltd, the UK’s largest privately owned delivery carrier specialising in irregular and out-of-gauge freight, opens new depot in Carlisle.

Now fully operational it marks a significant step in the company’s continued nationwide expansion.

The new 4,941ft² facility serves 67 postcodes across the Northwest of England and Southern Scotland, closing a gap in XDP’s regional coverage to give faster transit times, and increased capacity for businesses and consumers in the area.

By establishing a stronger local presence in the Carlisle area, XDP is better positioned to support growing customer demand while maintaining the high standards of reliability and service that customers have come to expect.

Isabella Wayte, managing director of XDP Ltd said: “The opening of our Carlisle depot demonstrates the continued growth of XDP’s national network.

# FST Logistics Expands Central Ohio Presence with New West Jefferson, Ohio Facility 

Dublin, OH – FST Logistics, a leading third-party logistics provider specializing in temperature-controlled transportation, retail consolidation, warehousing and supply chain solutions, is proud to announce the expansion of its Central Ohio footprint with the opening of a new facility in West Jefferson, Ohio. The new location adds 343,500 square feet of warehouse space to FST’s growing network and strengthens the company’s ability to support customers’ growth throughout the Midwest and beyond. 

The expansion provides additional capacity for FST to support the evolving needs of its customers, while creating opportunities to serve new customers seeking strategic warehousing and distribution solutions in Central Ohio. # Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot

 October 12, 2026 Mark Salisbury Filed under: Last Mile Deliveries, Logistics, Manufacturer News, News, Newsletter, Secondary News, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) 

Evri Group has opened a new £1.3 million depot in Gloucester, expanding its parcel delivery network across the South West and creating dozens of permanent jobs.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.

By Josh Croup

Published: Sep. 29, 2026 at 5:28 PM EDT

FINDLAY, Ohio (WTVG) - Sheetz cut the ribbon Tuesday on a new food production and distribution facility in Findlay that is bringing hundreds of new jobs to the area.

The $169 million facility has been five years in the making and will be a key part of the company’s efforts to expand across the Midwest.

“It really enables us for the growth that we have planned,” Sheetz CEO Travis Sheetz said. “We’re growing in Ohio with 140 stores today and many more to come. #### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.

G10 invested about $2 million in the Kenosha buildout, which Becker said covered racking, automation and staffing costs.

# AIT expands German home delivery operation after winning new contracts

By Carol Millett 2026-07-20T11:06:00+01:00

AIT Home Delivery says it has established a two-person next-day delivery network in Germany less than a year after launching operations in the country.

The company, a subsidiary of AIT Worldwide Logistics, said it has secured a number of customer contracts and opened a warehousing and distribution facility in Hannover to support its expansion.

AIT Home Delivery launched its German operation in September 2025 as part of its strategy to expand its specialist home delivery services across mainland Europe.

According to AIT, the operation now provides next-day coverage to 94% of Germany’s main population centres through its two-person home delivery network.

The Hannover site has capacity for around 9,000 pallet spaces and acts as a hub for warehousing, order fulfilment and final-mile distribution.
